Every 1862 reading in this entry rests on that book's whole-book text layer alone - this repository holds no page images for its temporal run - so where that layer damages a word the letterforms are inferred from the 1922 Mame at the same place rather than read. The 1862's own locus for this day scores only 0.58 on a token-level alignment; every difference behind that score is recogniser damage (accents dropped, words split at line breaks, running heads and the scan's watermark intruding), not a different petition. propers.text:
Praesta nobis, quaesumus, Domine, auxilium gratiae tuae: ut, jejuniis et
orationibus convenienter intenti, liberemur ab hostibus mentis et corporis.
Per Dominum.
